judgment.reason: Answer B uses the correct idiomatic approach (using hashable items directly as OrderedDict keys) and provides complete code with three assert tests, though the third test incorrectly expects sorted output from a set (violating the 'do not sort' constraint and relying on undefined set iteration order).
